class.name: InputBinding
class.brief_description: One stable and optionally rebindable physical input slot.
class.description: Use a binding in [member InputActionMapping.bindings]. A key starts on the X component. To make it drive a vector action forward along negative Y, add [InputSwapAxis] and then [InputInvert] with Y enabled and X disabled. Each slot has a unique ID even when several contribute to the same action.

method.name: get_action
method.description: Returns the owning action ID on a detached runtime binding snapshot. Returns an empty name on an authored binding.

method.name: set_mouse_motion
method.description: Assigns relative mouse motion with the selected screen axes and an identity pixel scale. Use on a Motion action. This replaces the previous physical source and preserves the stable ID and modifier list.

members.member: Compatibility gain or direction applied before modifiers. An individual key, button, or signed axis starts on X by default. Use [InputSwapAxis], [InputInvert], and [InputScale] to transform new bindings. Legacy mouse motion applies this gain to the selected raw screen axes. A whole stick supplies its signed X and Y directly.
Optional label for this slot in controls settings. Use a label such as Move Forward to distinguish directional slots.

Physical control assigned to this slot. Keys, mouse buttons, gamepad buttons, and signed gamepad axis directions can drive level actions. Mouse motion drives relative motion actions. Assigning a nonempty event clears [member stick]. Use device -1 on a gamepad event to accept the local scope's assigned gamepad.
Stable, nonempty identifier unique across the layout. Preserve this value when changing the physical event so saved rebinding profiles still identify this slot.

Transforms applied from first to last, after reading the raw source and applying any compatibility contribution. The action combines the result with its other bindings. Choose modifiers compatible with the action's value kind.

Screen axes read from an existing [InputEventMouseMotion] source. An axis retains its screen position, so Mouse Y gives [code]Vector2(0, dy)[/code]. Changing this field preserves the gain. Use [method set_mouse_motion] to create a new mouse source with identity gain.
Paired X and Y axes on the assigned gamepad. Use a whole stick with a Vector action. Selecting a stick clears [member event]. Edit the binding resource to change a whole-stick source.

constants.constant: Use both axes of the assigned gamepad's left stick.
Use both axes of the assigned gamepad's right stick.
Read horizontal and vertical screen motion together.
Read horizontal screen motion. The Y component starts at zero.
Read vertical screen motion. The X component starts at zero.
